findings.value: A Grade II-listed music hall in east London that presents theatre and music. Time Out describes it as one of the oldest surviving grand music halls.

evidence.quote: We present extraordinary theatre and music in the oldest Grand Music Hall in the world.
This Grade II-listed east London gem is the oldest surviving Grand Music Hall in the world.
from opera, musicals and concerts to touring dates for big-name theatre shows

findings.value: Mostly staged theatre, opera and concerts, plus touring theatre shows, with a large run of productions each year.

evidence.quote: These days it stages more 300 performances a year, encompassing an eclectic range of more than 80 different productions

notes: Time Out's review page is dated 2025-07-14 in its structured data. Its other dates look like a site-wide stamp, so only the 2025 date is recorded. No status news found; the venue's own site lists shows on sale for October 2026. Web search budget ran out during this run, so further press reviews were not checked.
